given: A flow starts a script that exists, and that script derives a helper path from its own location; the helper was renamed away, so the derived target no longer exists.
when: The referenced-path gate resolves the flow's script reference and then the script's own references.

expected.side_effects: the gate names the script and the line of the dead reference, so the flow is not delivered against a helper that will never be invoked

trigger.sandbox: the shape is built under the system temp directory by tests/gate-cases.Tests.ps1; nothing is written under the repository's business\

why: The other gates read structure; none of them opens the script a flow starts. So a helper path that outlived a rename stays invisible: the flow runs, the helper is never invoked, and the result file is never written.
